# Metric library: its records

Generated from `src/modules/metrics/types.ts` (every record, field and the comment written beside it). The metric library's records (backlog 0b), owned by the module since AS part 2: a metric, and a goal's link to the metric that measures it. They live in the workspace under `modules.metrics` (domain/records): `metrics` and `metricLinks`, as records.ts declares them. Stored in okr_metrics and okr_goal_metrics (migration 0033).

The module’s own records, not the core’s: the core keeps them without knowing what they are (`src/domain/records.ts`), filed in the workspace and in a save under `modules.metrics`. How each is declared, as `module.json` lists it:

| Record | Table | Filed under | Removable |
|---|---|---|---|
| metric | `okr_metrics` | `modules.metrics.metrics` | yes: restorable from Recently removed |
| metric link | `okr_goal_metrics` | `modules.metrics.metricLinks` | no |

## MetricDirection

Whether a bigger number is better (deploys a day) or a smaller one (build time).

```ts
type MetricDirection = 'higher' | 'lower'
```

## MetricRefresh

How often a metric's source refreshes its number.

```ts
type MetricRefresh = 'live' | 'hourly' | 'daily' | 'weekly' | 'monthly' | 'quarterly'
```

## MetricMeasurement

Whether the number is measured today (MS): in full, in part (some of it, or not every period), or not yet (a gap).

```ts
type MetricMeasurement = 'measured' | 'partly' | 'gap'
```

## Metric

A metric in the library (backlog 0b): one definition of a number, shared by every goal it measures, so two goals about "build time" mean the same build time. The rules are in rules.ts: a name, a unit and a direction are required; the rest is optional. Anyone can add one; its owner or an admin changes or removes it. Stored in okr_metrics.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `Id` | yes |  |
| `name` | `string` | yes |  |
| `meaning` | `string` | yes | What it means and how it's calculated, in words: what's counted, over what, and what's left out. |
| `unit` | `string` | yes |  |
| `decimals` | `number` | yes | Places after the decimal point it's shown with. |
| `direction` | `MetricDirection` | yes |  |
| `source` | `string` | yes | Where the number comes from (a dashboard, a tool, a query) and who owns that source (a team or a person, as text). |
| `sourceOwner` | `string` | yes |  |
| `refresh` | `MetricRefresh \| null` | yes | How often the source refreshes; null when nobody has said. |
| `ownerId` | `Id` | yes | The person who answers for the definition: whoever added it, unless they hand it on. |
| `caveats` | `string` | yes | What to watch out for when reading it (a known gap, a change of method). |
| `measurement` | `MetricMeasurement` | no | Whether it is measured today (MS; rulesMeasured.ts): absent on one never said otherwise, which is measured. Goals measured by a metric with a gap are held to no number (domain/unmeasured) until it is measured. |
| `measurementNote` | `string` | no | What's missing from the measurement, and who is sorting it out ('' or absent when measured). |
| `level` | `import('./rulesStructure').MetricLevel` | no | Structure (MQ; rulesStructure.ts): how it relates to its parent metric (absent: not said). |
| `parentId` | `Id` | no | The metric it is a component, driver, control or breakdown of (absent: none). |
| `confidence` | `import('./rulesStructure').MetricConfidence` | no | How far its number can be trusted (absent: not said). |
| `gaming` | `string` | no | How the number could be gamed, in words (absent: not said). |
| `createdBy` | `Id` | yes |  |
| `createdAt` | `string` | yes |  |
| `updatedAt` | `string` | yes |  |
| `removedAt` | `string \| null` | no | Removed: kept, out of every list, restorable (domain/removal). |
| `removedBy` | `Id \| null` | no |  |
| `retiredAt` | `string \| null` | no | Retired (MT3): out of the pickers and the library's list, its links kept and its goals still measured by it; brought back by clearing these. Absent on a metric never retired; null and '' once brought back. |
| `retiredBy` | `Id \| null` | no |  |
| `retiredWhy` | `string` | no |  |
| `replacedBy` | `Id \| null` | no | The metric its goals' owners are offered in its place (same unit), when the person retiring it named one. |
| `marks` | `MetricMark[]` | no | Changes of meaning or direction its goals show on their chart and History (rule 4), oldest first. |

## MetricMark

A change to a metric its goals must show (MT3 rule 4): what it meant, or which way was better, from a week on.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `week` | `number` | yes | The cycle week it was made in, and when. |
| `at` | `string` | yes |  |
| `by` | `Id` | yes |  |
| `kind` | `'definition' \| 'direction'` | yes |  |
| `why` | `string` | yes |  |
| `was` | `string` | yes | The two texts (meaning) or directions, before and after. |
| `now` | `string` | yes |  |

## MetricLink

A goal measured by a metric, for one slice: a team's number (teamId), or the whole company's (null). One per goal: its id is the goal's id. The goal's own target (its plan's target, or its range's limit) is the target in that metric; nothing is copied. Unlinking sets removedAt, so it can be undone. Stored in okr_goal_metrics.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `Id` | yes | The goal's id: one link per goal. |
| `goalId` | `Id` | yes |  |
| `metricId` | `Id` | yes |  |
| `teamId` | `Id \| null` | yes |  |
| `part` | `string` | no | Which part of the team's or the company's number (“tier-1 services”, a region); empty or absent for all of it (MT2). Absent on a link that never had one, so its row doesn't name the column; '' when a part was cleared. |
| `linkedBy` | `Id` | yes |  |
| `linkedAt` | `string` | yes |  |
| `removedAt` | `string \| null` | no |  |
| `removedBy` | `Id \| null` | no |  |
